title: What Laptop Should I Buy for SOLIDWORKS? (2026): Certified Graphics, RAM and the Windows 11 Home Trap
summary: SOLIDWORKS 2026 needs Windows 11 Pro, 16-32 GB RAM and certified graphics. Its 975 certified configs include no GeForce card, but do include integrated chips.
body_markdown:
## What laptop should I buy for SOLIDWORKS?


**A laptop running Windows 11 Pro, with 16 GB RAM (32 GB recommended), an SSD and a graphics chip on SOLIDWORKS's certified list.** That list has 975 certified configurations and not one gaming GeForce card. It does include some integrated graphics in business laptops. A gaming laptop runs SOLIDWORKS, but outside what Dassault tests.


We read SOLIDWORKS's[hardware certification list](https://www.solidworks.com/support/hardware-certification) on **18 November 2026** and its[system requirements](https://www.solidworks.com/support/system-requirements) on 17 November 2026. This guide is a spoke of our main[laptop guide for engineering students](https://resources.skill-lync.com/articles/best-laptop-for-engineering-students-india/) .


## What are the SOLIDWORKS 2026 system requirements?


Requirement SOLIDWORKS 2026 (official)


Operating system **Windows 11, 64-bit.** Home editions are not supported


RAM 16 GB minimum, **32 GB recommended**


Processor x86-64 (Intel 64 or AMD64)


Graphics **Certified cards and drivers**


Storage SSD recommended


Mac Parallels Desktop supported; Boot Camp not supported


Windows 10 support ended with SOLIDWORKS 2025 SP5, so a laptop for SOLIDWORKS 2026 must run Windows 11.


## Can SOLIDWORKS run on Windows 11 Home?


**It is not supported.** SOLIDWORKS's requirements exclude Windows Home editions. Many budget laptops in India ship with Windows 11 Home, and it is the most common trap in "cheapest laptop for SOLIDWORKS" searches.


Check the edition on the spec sheet before you pay. If the laptop you want comes with Home, budget for an upgrade to Windows 11 Pro.

## Does SOLIDWORKS need a certified graphics card?


**Officially, yes: "certified cards and drivers".** Certification means Dassault tested that exact laptop model with that graphics chip and that driver version. Think of it like a part approved for a specific car: the same brake pad may fit another car, but nobody tested it there.


Here is what the certified list contained on 18 November 2026:


- **975 certified configurations** across SOLIDWORKS 2024, 2025 and 2026, from Dell, HP, Lenovo, MSI, ASUS, Acer, Fujitsu and BOXX.
- **No GeForce card at all.** Every NVIDIA entry is a professional card: RTX Ada Generation, RTX A-series, RTX PRO Blackwell, Quadro and T-series.
- **Some integrated graphics are certified** , in specific business laptops. The AMD Radeon 780M is certified for SOLIDWORKS 2026 in the Lenovo ThinkPad P14s Gen 4, ThinkPad P16s Gen 2 and HP ZBook Firefly 14 G11 A. The Intel Arc Pro 140T is certified in the HP ZBook 8 G1i 14, HP ZBook X G1i 16 and Dell Pro Max 14 and 16.
- The entry-level professional **RTX 2000 Ada Generation** appears in 47 configurations, including the ThinkPad P16v Gen 1 and Gen 2, Dell Precision 7680 and 3581, and HP ZBook Power 15.6 G10.


That third point surprises most students. A ThinkPad P14s with integrated Radeon 780M graphics is certified for SOLIDWORKS 2026. A gaming laptop with a far more powerful GeForce RTX card is not.


Certification also unlocks features. SOLIDWORKS's certification page tells users to install a patch if "your professional graphics card is not recognized for RealView and Enhanced Graphics Performance". RealView is the realistic-appearance mode, and those features are tied to recognised professional cards.


## Is a gaming laptop OK for SOLIDWORKS?


**For learning, usually yes. For support, no.** A GeForce RTX laptop has plenty of power for student parts and assemblies. But it is not a certified configuration, so if a display glitch or crash comes from the graphics driver, Dassault and your reseller can say it is unsupported.

What that means in practice:


- **First- and second-year coursework:** a gaming laptop with 16 GB RAM, an SSD and Windows 11 Pro is fine.
- **Final-year project, internships or freelance CAD work:** prefer a certified mobile workstation, because stability matters more than speed.
